<b>Pollip Pouch</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It applies venom to equipped {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}, making them deal extra damage over time.

== Usefulness ==
With the Pollip Pouch equipped, when a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} hits an enemy, venom is applied to them that deals 2 ticks of damage. This effect does not apply to the [[Needle Phial]].

The damage of each tick depends on the number of [[Crafting Kit]]s that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has. Venom ticks deal 1 damage when Hornet has no kits, 2 damage when she has 1–2 kits, and 3 damage when she has 3–4 kits. Hitting an enemy that has been envenomed resets the effect.
* Due to poison damage being unaffected by [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)#Damage Calculation|Enemy Damage Modifiers]], it is particularly helpful against high-HP enemies, especially during the mid-game when other damage outputs might not yet match the increased enemy HP triggered by Needle upgrades.

* Pollip Pouch synergises extremely well with the [[Architect Crest]] thanks to its strong reliance on {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} during combat.
** It is not recommended to use Pollip Pouch with the Architect Crest's [[Plasmification]] build though, as it will destroy the Plasmium gained from the [[Plasmium Phial]].
* Enemies cannot be affected by multiple sources of venom at the same time. So, to deal the most damage, it's more effective to wait out each instance of venom until the previous one has expired.
* If an enemy disappears and then reappears somewhere else (or teleports), then any venom applied to the enemy is removed. This is assumedly because the game resets the enemy's state when spawning in a new sprite.
* [[Sister Splinter]] and [[The Unravelled]] do not take damage from the venom of the Pollip Pouch.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JXUtfO6UQXo&t=1123s Video showing Pollip Pouch immunity]</ref>
* Enemies damaged by a tool affected by the Pollip Pouch will <b>not drop [[Seared Organ]]s</b>.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Greyroot]] in [[Shellwood]] after completing the <i>[[Rite of the Pollip]]</i> [[Wish]].
